_about: Participant-built evaluation cases. Each mutates one public sample request and states the expected answer, derived by hand from participant-visible evidence (see evaluation/evaluation_report.md).

override.request_text: Please send me a copy of the data you hold on this account. I still use it, so do not delete or change anything.

cases.tests: Intent: deletion vocabulary inside an explicit non-deletion request must not authorize deletion.
Identity: the request arrives with the subject's previous email (user_audit_log audit_282); the analytics record is only linked through sha256(old email).
Identity: email matching must be case-insensitive.
Time cutoff: the 09-15 11:44 readback (evidence_92) did not exist at a 09:00 audit, so it must not be cited; only the 09-05 post-request account inventory (evidence_90) can prove the profile absent.
